THC is not water soluble so putting it in during the boil or while fermenting will not get you much of anything other that aromatics and flavor. Hops are members of the cannaboid family, so that's fine but probably not what you are after.

If you want the THC in the final product use high proof grain alcohol (like Everclear) to disolve the THC and then strain and add to the beer before bottling or kegging. Since you will be bumping the alcohol percentage I would recommend a low gravity beer to start with. A nice brown ale or porter should help hide the taste of the Everclear.

Most of the fun parts are alcohol soluble, not water soluble. Most of the carcinogenic parts are water soluble, not alcohol soluble (although, most of those are only released in smoke, not the plant itself).
